ext_description.message: Paste a link, get a timestamped summary in claude.ai — YouTube, podcasts, articles.

url_placeholder.message: YouTube, podcast RSS, Apple Podcasts, article…

status_done.message: Sent to claude.ai (also copied to clipboard, just in case).

footer_note.message: Works for YouTube, podcast RSS/Apple Podcasts feeds with a transcript tag, and article pages. No yt-dlp or speech-to-text here — for sites without ready captions, use the skimcast Claude Code plugin instead.
